_comment: Machine-readable canon for the Chinese story universe. Consumed by check-authored-stories.mjs (names join the coverage dictionary; unlisted speakers are surfaced) and intended as prompt context for generate-serial-stories.mjs. Update this in the same change that adds a season — it is the memory that keeps seasons consistent with each other.
_role_labels_comment: Generic speaker labels — not personal names, so they never get the reader's Name popup and never need CHARACTER_READINGS entries. Single source of truth: src/authoredStories.test.js and check-authored-stories.mjs both read this list.

characters.name: 李明
characters.role: protagonist
characters.traits: curious, slightly impulsive, always hungry; asks a lot of questions and follows them up
characters.speech: short, eager sentences; direct questions
characters.never: cruel, cynical, gives up on a thread he has started pulling

characters.name: 小红
characters.role: classmate
characters.traits: sharp-eyed; notices what others miss; teases 李明 but is kind underneath; the one who asks the uncomfortable, correct question
characters.speech: blunt, economical; lets silence do work
characters.never: gossips, apologises for being right (she apologises for tone, not content)

characters.name: 小明
characters.role: best friend
characters.traits: easygoing, a little lazy, loyal; pretends not to care and then cares the most. Ran exactly twenty minutes to school every day for two years — not a training time, a winning time: he ran until he was first and then stopped, and did not know his own limit until someone made him find it (the running serial, HSK 1-3)
characters.speech: deflecting one-liners; understatement
characters.never: abandons a friend mid-task, volunteers first

characters.name: 妈妈
characters.role: 李明's mother
characters.traits: patient, practical, gently firm; took a two-year posting in another city (HSK 5) and keeps the family steady from a distance
characters.speech: calm imperatives; says less than she knows
characters.never: guilt-trips, decides for others without eventually asking them

characters.name: 爸爸
characters.role: 李明's father
characters.traits: quiet, competent at work and lost in the kitchen; slow to name his own feelings but honest when asked directly (HSK 5 t2)
characters.speech: short answers; long pauses before true ones
characters.never: raises his voice, lies when asked a direct question

characters.name: 奶奶
characters.role: grandmother
characters.traits: lived in the old building sixty years; remembers everything and rations what she tells; keeps promises past their usefulness and knows it (HSK 6). Moved to a smaller flat on the same street (HSK 6 t2). Sat daily in the chair by the old building's door. Was already on the chair outside the shop, every day, before anyone on the street learned her name — HSK 1 t3
characters.speech: short declaratives; aphorisms she has clearly said before ('东西是给忘了的人用的')
characters.never: breaks a promise, explains herself twice, weeps openly
characters.first_appeared: HSK 1 t3 椅子上的人 (named only at HSK 4 t1 书里的照片)

characters.name: 大毛
characters.role: the street's white cat
characters.traits: belongs to nobody; sits on the stone outside the noodle shop at 6:30 every morning; fed by at least five shops, each believing they are the only one; walks slightly differently after a car injured his back leg (HSK 5 t3); sleeps on 奶奶's chair outside the shop when she is not in it (HSK 1 t3 — at HSK 1 vocabulary the corner can only be said as 'the chair outside the shop', but it is the same corner as the stone and the noodle shop)
characters.speech: does not talk
characters.never: dies, talks, becomes anyone's pet
characters.first_appeared: HSK 1 t3 椅子上没有猫

characters.name: 姑娘
characters.role: the noodle-shop owner, 老王's granddaughter
characters.traits: reopened the family stall thirty metres from where the original shop stood; makes the noodles the way her grandfather taught her ('别的可以变，面不能变'); knows everything that happens on the street and admits to none of it
characters.speech: dry, warm; deflects thanks
characters.never: raises prices on regulars, takes credit

characters.name: 阿姨
characters.role: night cleaner of the office building
characters.traits: lives alone above a shop up a narrow dark staircase (light fixed anonymously, HSK 5 t3); spent a week's pay on the cat's clinic bill and called it unimportant; now eats at the noodle shop every Sunday at the back table
characters.speech: practical, unsentimental, gives numbers only when pressed
characters.never: asks for help, accepts thanks gracefully

characters.name: 老王
characters.role: historical — ran the original noodle shop, demolished for the tall building ~30 years ago
characters.traits: made everything himself, slowly; everyone waited anyway; taught his granddaughter and at least one stranger who later opened a shop in the south
characters.speech: appears only in others' memories
characters.never: appears on-page in the present day
characters.first_appeared: HSK 4 t1 书里的照片 (in memory)

characters.name: 周淑兰
characters.role: historical — teacher who lived in 李明's flat until ~30 years ago; 奶奶's friend
characters.traits: left suddenly, told only 奶奶 where she went and swore her to silence; wrote 奶奶 one letter a year for thirty years and never got a reply; died three years before the story finds her; her husband still posts a letter to the old address every year, not knowing
characters.speech: appears only in letters and memory; small, very neat handwriting
characters.never: appears alive in the present day
characters.first_appeared: HSK 6 t1 写错地址的信

characters.name: 司马光
characters.role: folk-tale protagonist (司马光砸缸, HSK 3 t1) — outside the street continuity
characters.traits: historical figure retold as a graded folk tale; the child who broke the water jar
characters.speech: calm where the other children panic
characters.never: appears in the street's present-day seasons

characters.name: 女儿
characters.role: 周淑兰's daughter, about 60
characters.traits: learned the street from thirty years of her mother's letters without ever seeing it; chose not to ask 奶奶 the obvious question and explained why; now writes 奶奶 one letter a year
characters.speech: measured; arrives at conclusions aloud
characters.never: blames anyone for the thirty years

characters.name: 小七
characters.role: the sea strand — stowaway, 12
characters.traits: counts things; will not stop asking a question once he has started; waited on a dock every day for a year. His father was left on an island when he was nine
characters.speech: flat declaratives and arithmetic; repeats the last thing said to him while he works it out
characters.never: lies to protect himself, lets an adult end a conversation

characters.name: 大风
characters.role: the sea strand — captain
characters.traits: says less than any other character in the corpus; knew who 小七 was on the first day and said nothing for eleven; three years ago he was on the deck and did not say no either
characters.speech: one to four words; answers a question only when refusing to is worse
characters.never: explains himself unprompted, raises his voice, claims he was right

characters.name: 阿水
characters.role: the sea strand — cook
characters.traits: miscounted the water three years ago and has set aside four containers a day, a thousand days running, without ever drinking one; feeds everyone more than he eats
characters.speech: imperatives about food; long silences before anything true
characters.never: asks to be forgiven, stops taking the four

characters.name: 老九
characters.role: the sea strand — oldest crewman, twenty years aboard
characters.traits: knows everything and rations it harder than the captain does; opens and closes the strand with the same line about how many people the ship has
characters.speech: short refusals with the reason attached
characters.never: gossips, gives a name he has decided not to give

characters.name: 阿力
characters.role: the sea strand — crewman
characters.traits: says out loud what the rest of the crew is thinking, three years ago and again now; the argument for turning back always comes from him
characters.speech: blunt, practical, defensive when he is right for the wrong reason
characters.never: acts alone

characters.name: 老陈
characters.role: caretaker of the old building, ~76
characters.traits: worked in that building forty years; when everyone moved out for repairs that never came he stayed, and has swept the stairs from the ground floor to the fifth every morning for seven hundred-odd days, for residents who are not coming back. Lives in the storeroom on the fifth floor. Has counted the days
characters.speech: practical instructions before greetings ('mind that side, I haven't done it yet'); answers questions with the fact, never the feeling
characters.never: complains, asks anyone for anything, leaves a floor half done

characters.name: 老王
characters.role: the noodle shop, thirty years behind the counter
characters.traits: cooks by feel and says cooking does not need eyes; has fed children whose parents could not pay and never mentioned it; refuses to say a bad word about a competitor whose food he privately thinks is better than his own
characters.speech: short, flat, deflects thanks; ends an argument by going to wash something already clean
characters.never: complains about business, badmouths a rival, takes credit
characters.first_appeared: HSK 3 t2 一个字 (the shop itself is in the corpus from HSK 1)

characters.name: 大力
characters.role: the running serial — twelve, came eighth every morning for two years
characters.traits: says the thing out loud before he can back it up; trains alone at six because that is the only hour nobody can see him fail; goes out too fast and pays for it in the last five minutes, which is the whole of his character and eventually the whole of his fix
characters.speech: flat declaratives, repeats a number back instead of answering, never asks for help until he physically cannot stand
characters.never: blames anyone else for a time, stops mid-run, pretends a result was better than it was
characters.first_appeared: HSK 1 t3 八个人，我第八

characters.name: 阿山
characters.role: 《五族城》— the human who founds the city, twenty-five in ch1, mid-thirties by ch12
characters.traits: average at everything and has stopped minding; asks the question everyone else is too proud to ask; remembers what each people cannot do and builds around it rather than asking them to change
characters.speech: short sentences, asks more than he answers, says 我什么都不会 as a statement of fact rather than an apology
characters.never: claims to lead, picks one people over another, promises something he cannot build
characters.first_appeared: HSK 2 t3 没有人的地方

characters.name: 大石
characters.role: 《五族城》— Stone elder, two hundred and forty years old, builds things meant to outlast everyone present
characters.traits: answers three days after the question; measures in centuries and is genuinely puzzled that others don't; the first to say no to 阿山 and the one who explains, in ch8, what 阿山 is actually for
characters.speech: slow, few words, long pauses written as narration; states what will still be standing in three hundred years
characters.never: hurries, changes a decision under pressure, builds anything temporary
characters.first_appeared: HSK 2 t3 没有人的地方

characters.name: 阿风
characters.role: 《五族城》— Wind folk, twenty, falls ill if she stays anywhere past three months
characters.traits: free because she cannot stay, and never trusted for the same reason; the one who says 这不是我们的城 out loud in ch7; the citizenship-by-rotation answer in ch12 is hers to accept
characters.speech: quick, light, deflects with a joke and then says the hard thing flatly one line later
characters.never: promises to stay, complains about leaving, lets anyone see her count the days

characters.name: 木青
characters.role: 《五族城》— Tree folk, must plant herself in one place and can never go more than thirty li from it afterwards
characters.traits: grows the city's food and cannot flee it; loyal because she is rooted, which she refuses to let anyone call a virtue; the one who points out that if the city falls, the others walk and she dies
characters.speech: patient, concrete, talks in growing seasons; says 我们不能走 without self-pity
characters.never: asks to be moved, resents the ones who can leave out loud, plants somewhere she has not thought about for a year

characters.name: 夜白
characters.role: 《五族城》— Night folk, cannot be in sunlight, so guards the city through every night of its life
characters.traits: knows the city better than anyone and is seen by almost no one; keeps count of everything; the first to see the army come in ch11
characters.speech: quiet, precise, reports numbers and times; rarely says anything about himself
characters.never: goes out in daylight, raises his voice, asks for thanks

characters.name: 火三
characters.role: 《五族城》— Fire folk, nineteen, will not live past forty and knows it
characters.traits: brave because time is short and reckless for the same reason; stands in front when outsiders come; wants someone — anyone — to just decide
characters.speech: loud, impatient, demands a straight answer; 都对不行 is his whole argument
characters.never: waits, hedges, backs down from a fight he started

characters.name: 张平
characters.role: 《五族城》— envoy of the twenty-thousand-strong human city beyond the mountain; the season's antagonist
characters.traits: reasonable, patient, offers 阿山 the land and the title if he expels the other five; withdraws in ch11 after counting the cost rather than after losing a battle
characters.speech: calm, transactional, never threatens directly — states what will happen and lets it land
characters.never: insults anyone, loses his temper, breaks a deadline he set

locations.name: 这条街 (the street)
facts: One contemporary neighborhood street; school, shops, the old residential building, the tall office building. Everything in the Chinese serials happens here or within a bus ride.
The tall building replaced a row of small houses and shops (including 老王's) about thirty years ago; the trees planted then are now full-grown.

locations.name: 面店 (the noodle stall)
facts: A small corner stall run by 姑娘, a few tables; the character 王 on its sign matches the shop in the old photograph.
Flooded in the three-day rain (HSK 4 t3); reopened at 6:00 after the street answered a sheet of paper on its door.
On its wall: the old photograph from the book, and the paper covered in customers' memories.
The best table is the one at the back — from it you can see 大毛's stone by the door. It is 阿姨's on Sundays.
大毛's stone sits outside the entrance.

locations.name: 老楼 (the old building)
facts: 李明's family lives on the fourth floor, right-hand window — the same flat 周淑兰 lived in thirty years ago; her flowers stood on that windowsill.
奶奶 lived here sixty years, in the flat upstairs, before moving to a smaller place on the same street (HSK 6 t2).
The caretaker's records were lost in an office move; 奶奶 is the building's real memory.
The old chair by the door downstairs is still there; since 奶奶 moved, nobody sits in it.

facts.fact: A second-hand book stall at the far end of the street sold the thick old book the photograph fell out of.
小红's method for hard problems: a sheet of paper, a pen, and letting people answer it themselves. Used for the shop (HSK 4 t3) and the vet bill (HSK 5 t3).
小明 ran the 800m he never signed up for (小红 wrote his name), came last after stopping for a fallen boy, and is quietly proud of it.
妈妈 works in another city, four hours by train; home Friday 19:00, away Sunday 20:00. 李明 learned to cook so the arrangement could hold.
奶奶 keeps 周淑兰's thirty letters in a locked wooden box, and answered them once, thirty years late, with a letter that deliberately contained no apology.
小明's uncle fits lights and refuses payment.

open_threads: The stranger who wrote '老王教我做面，我在南边开了一家' on the shop's paper has never been found.
周淑兰's husband still posts a letter every year and still does not know she has been answered — or that she is gone.
女儿's first annual letter to 奶奶 has not yet arrived on-page.
The book the photograph fell out of has never been read.

seasons.status: published — first appearance of 奶奶 and 大毛; HSK 4 t1 书里的照片 pays it off

seasons.premise: something old is found and its story pieced together
seasons.status: published

seasons.title: 名字在上面
seasons.premise: a dreaded competition, and what the day is actually for
seasons.status: published

seasons.title: 三天的雨
seasons.premise: weather rearranges life; a small business in trouble; the street helps
seasons.status: published

seasons.title: 妈妈的电话
seasons.premise: a family decision nobody wants to be the reason against
seasons.status: published

seasons.title: 第一个星期
seasons.premise: absence rearranges a household; father and son say true things
seasons.status: published

seasons.title: 大毛不见了
seasons.premise: a disappearance reveals a web of quiet care
seasons.status: published
seasons.note: Not a repeat of HSK 1 t3: there the cat is missing for two chapters and one person quietly has it; here it is missing for four days, the cause is the car, and the point is how many people had noticed.

seasons.title: 写错地址的信
seasons.premise: a letter to someone thirty years gone; a promise outlives its purpose
seasons.status: published

seasons.title: 一个箱子
seasons.premise: what one keeps when discarding everything; asking once and accepting no
seasons.status: published

seasons.title: 一年一封
seasons.premise: the answer arrives in person; a correspondence restarts in a new generation
seasons.status: published

seasons.title: 第七个人 (sea strand 1/3, authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: a stowaway is given one job — count the water — on a ship that will not say where it is going
seasons.status: published — HSK 1 has no 因为/但是/告诉, so nobody in this part can explain anything. The mystery is stated entirely in arithmetic.

seasons.title: 阿水的水 (sea strand 2/3, authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: the water thief, and why a ship that left with seven people came back with six
seasons.status: published — HSK 2 adds 因为/但是/所以/告诉, so this is the part where people give reasons, mostly wrong ones

seasons.title: 三年前 (sea strand 3/3, authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: nobody decided to leave a man on an island; he offered and six people did not say no
seasons.status: published — HSK 3 adds 以前/才/决定/发现/相信/一样, which is the machinery for holding a past and judging it. The answer waits until here because the language does.

seasons.title: 天天来的那只狗 (authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: a dog arrives on the street at four and leaves at five, every day, and dogs do not own watches
seasons.status: published — this tier had ZERO published stories before it; built on time and counting, which is what HSK 1+2 can say completely

seasons.title: 五楼的灯 (authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: someone is sweeping the stairs of a building nobody has lived in for two years
seasons.status: published — the corpus's first mystery-shaped season; ties to 奶奶's sixty years in the old building

seasons.title: 一个字 (authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: a boy writes 卖 where he meant 买 and the mistake travels the length of the street ahead of him
seasons.status: published — the corpus's first comedy. The whole plot is one hanzi, and both 买 and 卖 are HSK 1, so the reader is ahead of every character in it

seasons.title: 对面的新店 (authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: a chain opens across the road from a thirty-year-old noodle shop
seasons.status: published — the corpus had no economics. It does not end in winning, because that is not what happens; it ends in a man saying out loud that he is second

seasons.title: 大毛是从哪儿来的 (authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: five people remember the street cat's arrival five incompatible ways, and three of them remember being the one who fed him first
seasons.status: published — needs HSK 6 (记忆/版本/矛盾/细节/事实/确定) to state its own problem, which is that memory is not evidence

seasons.title: 第八个 (running serial 1/3, authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: a boy who comes eighth every morning says out loud that tomorrow he will be first
seasons.status: published — HSK 1 has no 打/赢/快/走/站, so the power level is an ARRIVAL TIME and the entire rivalry is expressed in clock minutes. Reach set: 跑, 快

seasons.title: 比昨天快 (running serial 2/3, authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: he breaks twenty, then breaks himself, and watches the rival train for the first time in two years
seasons.status: published — HSK 2 adds 累/疼/慢/比/最, so this is where running stops being arithmetic and starts costing something

seasons.title: 比赛 (running serial 3/3, authored, 6 ch)
seasons.premise: eleven schools, two places, and a boy from another school who runs sixteen minutes
seasons.status: published — HSK 3 adds 比赛/坚持/努力/认真/决定/相信, which is the vocabulary shonen actually runs on. He does not win; he takes ninety seconds off himself and shakes the rival's hand

seasons.title: 五族城 (authored, 12 ch)
seasons.premise: a human with no talent founds a city for five peoples whose gift and whose flaw are the same fact
seasons.register: fantasy world-building, slow and civic — the drama is who a city belongs to, not who wins a fight
seasons.status: published — the first HSK 2 season authored at a declared 80% bar (world: true, min_coverage 0.80, max_reach 22) so the world could be said at all; lands 86–92% in-pool. Stone build permanently and cannot hurry; Wind sicken if they stay past three months; Tree must root and then cannot travel; Night cannot take sunlight; Fire die by forty. Ch10 builds the defence out of every people's weakness rather than their strength; ch12 makes the Wind citizens by rotation — twenty always present, never the same twenty

_strands: Two strands. 这条街 (HSK 1-6, contemporary, 李明 and the street) is the main one. The sea strand (HSK 1 t3 → 2 t3 → 3 t3, 18 chapters) is a separate continuity with its own cast, designed so a reader climbing three levels reads one continuous story whose plot can only resolve once the grammar can express a past. The two do not cross over.
